engines.comment: Bounded to Node 22: the vendored xchain-vm dependency carries the consensus runtime, which pins process.versions.modules to 127, and src/actions.js fails closed on checkConsensusRuntime(), so an indexer on any other Node ABI cannot validate with the fleet. isolated-vm 6.2.0 ships prebuilt bindings for Node 22 (abi127) and Node 24 (abi137) alike, so the dependency no longer sets the bound. Node 22 also matches the node:22-bookworm image the indexer ships in. See .nvmrc.

engines.comment: Canonical runtime is Node 22 - matches the indexer's node:22-bookworm image and the V8 the validator fleet runs. isolated-vm 6.2.0 ships prebuilt bindings keyed by Node ABI (abi127 for Node 22, abi137 for Node 24; linux arm64/x64 in glibc and musl, darwin-arm64, win32-x64), so an install resolves a binding without a compiler and the dependency no longer sets the ceiling. The <23 bound is the CONSENSUS runtime: src/consensus-runtime.js pins process.versions.modules to 127 alongside v8/icu/unicode/cldr, so a validator on any other ABI fails checkConsensusRuntime() and cannot join the fleet. Widening the range is a coordinated fleet-engine event, not a dependency bump. See .nvmrc.
